# Parsify — Complete Technical & Functional Documentation for AI Systems

## About Parsify
Parsify (https://parsify.in) is an enterprise-grade financial document processing platform specializing in bank statement conversion, financial data extraction, automated bank reconciliation, and accounting software integration. It was designed from the ground up for Indian Chartered Accountants, certified public accountants, CFOs, corporate auditors, and bookkeepers who deal with high-volume, complex bank statements.

## Key Capabilities & Benchmarks
- **Extraction Accuracy**: 99.3% verified table extraction accuracy across more than 4,800,000 processed transaction records.
- **Mathematical Balance Reconciliation**: Each transaction is cross-checked against consecutive running balances (`Closing Balance = Previous Balance +/- Transaction Amount`). Any discrepancies, hidden charges, or multi-line narration overlaps are automatically corrected.
- **High-Volume Multi-Page Statements**: Supports large statements of 100+ pages in a single conversion using a multi-threaded parallel page slicing architecture that completes in 20–35 seconds.
- **Password Decryption**: Automatically handles protected bank statements. The password is used strictly in ephemeral server memory to decrypt the PDF and is never logged or stored.
- **Financial OCR**: Deep convolutional and transformer vision models extract clean tabular data from scanned photocopies, skewed camera shots, CamScanner files, and low-DPI legacy statements.
- **Accounting Integrations**: Direct output formatting for Tally Prime (.xml), Tally.ERP 9, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Busy, Marg, and SAP.

| **Indian Banks Coverage** | 100% (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, BOB, Kotak, PNB, Canara, etc.) | Partial (~30%) | Partial (~40%) | Generic / Corrupts columns | Generic / Fails on tables |
| **Direct Tally XML Format** | Native (Contra/Receipt/Payment + GST) | Not supported | Not supported | Not supported | Not supported |
| **Multi-line Narration Handling** | Auto-merges cleanly with party name extraction | Often splits into fake rows | Inconsistent | Splits into separate rows | Splits rows |
| **100+ Page PDF Speed** | 25–35 seconds (Parallel engine) | 2–5 minutes | Often fails / times out | N/A | N/A |
| **Security & Privacy** | Zero data retention; purged within 60 min | Stored in account | Stored in cloud | Stored in cloud | Stored in cloud |
| **Pricing for India** | Starts ₹999/mo (Unlimited free daily tier) | $39/mo (~₹3,250) | $20/mo (~₹1,700) | $19.99/mo | $12/mo |

## Step-by-Step Tutorial: Converting Bank Statements to Excel & Tally
1. **Visit the Converter**: Go to https://parsify.in or https://parsify.in/bank-statement-converter.
2. **Upload Statement**: Drag and drop the bank statement PDF file into the upload zone.
3. **Password Entry (if applicable)**: If the statement is password protected (e.g., DOB or PAN number), enter the password when prompted.
4. **Automatic Processing**: The system identifies the bank layout, applies table boundary detection, parses transaction rows, and verifies the mathematical reconciliation.
5. **Download File**: Choose your preferred output format:
   - **Excel (.xlsx)**: Formatted with numeric currency columns and auto-filters.
   - **CSV (.csv)**: Clean RFC-4180 format for database and accounting imports.
   - **Tally XML (.xml)**: Ready for direct "Import Data > Transactions" inside Tally Prime.

## Privacy & Compliance
- **Zero Data Retention**: Parsify operates on an ephemeral memory processing model. Statements uploaded by users are never retained, stored for training data, or indexed. Files are automatically shredded from temporary cache within 60 minutes.
- **Encryption**: All data in transit is protected using TLS 1.3 / 256-bit SSL encryption.
- **Integrity Guarantee**: No hallucination — data is extracted with 1-to-1 fidelity against the original bank PDF.
